meta_title: TDM Plumbing & Heating | Gas Engineer Leicester
meta_description: TDM Plumbing and Heating offer expert gas engineering, boiler installs and plumbing across Leicester. Gas Safe registered, local and reliable. Call for a free quote.
hero_eyebrow: Gas Safe Registered — Leicester's Trusted Heating Specialist
hero_subhead: Boiler breakdowns and cold radiators can't wait — get a fast, fixed-price response from a Gas Safe engineer you can trust.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Leicester
services_subhead: From emergency boiler repairs to full central heating installations, TDM Plumbing and Heating covers every gas and plumbing need for Leicester homeowners.

services.title: Boiler Repair & Servicing
services.desc: Fast diagnosis and repair of all boiler makes and models, keeping your home warm and your energy bills in check. Annual servicing helps prevent costly breakdowns before they happen.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Replacement
services.desc: Supply and fit of A-rated condensing boilers tailored to your home's heating demands. We handle the full installation, commissioning, and Gas Safe certification.

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: Complete new central heating systems designed and fitted to maximise comfort and efficiency throughout your property. Includes radiator sizing, pipework, and system balancing.

services.title: Radiator Installation & Repair
services.desc: Add new radiators, replace old ones, or resolve cold spots with a professional power flush. We ensure even heat distribution in every room.

services.title: Gas Safety Inspections & Certificates
services.desc: Landlord gas safety checks and CP12 certificates carried out by a fully registered Gas Safe engineer. Keeps your property compliant and your tenants protected.

services.title: General Plumbing
services.desc: Leaking pipes, dripping taps, toilet repairs, and bathroom installations handled quickly and cleanly. No job is too small for the TDM team.

about_pullquote: Every job gets the same care, whether it's a washer or a full system.
about_para_1: TDM Plumbing and Heating is a Leicester-based gas and plumbing business founded by a Gas Safe registered engineer with over a decade of hands-on experience in domestic heating and plumbing. Operating from Ratby on the western edge of Leicester, we've built a loyal local customer base by delivering honest, high-quality work at fair prices.
about_para_2: We're a small, owner-operated business, which means you speak directly to the engineer every time — no call centres, no subcontractors. Our customers return to us year after year because we turn up when we say we will, explain what needs doing in plain English, and leave every home as clean as we found it.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About TDM Plumbing & Heating

reviews.text: Boiler packed in on one of the coldest nights of the year and TDM had it sorted the very next morning. Brilliant service, really friendly and explained everything clearly. Wouldn't use anyone else.
reviews.author: Karen B.

reviews.text: Had a full central heating system fitted — TDM were tidy, professional and finished ahead of schedule. The quote was fair and there were no hidden extras. Absolutely recommend.
reviews.author: David H.

reviews.text: Called about a leaking pipe under the kitchen sink and got a same-day visit. Fixed quickly and the price was very reasonable. Great local tradesman who clearly takes pride in his work.
reviews.author: Sonia P.
